elaine: Heads-up — customer (acct: acme-llm) hit repeated SSE disconnects with partial final chunks. They see long silence (~12-18s) mid-stream, then client reconnects and resumes but final partial event is truncated. Triage notes below.

kenji: Do we have a repro? which infra path (ALB/NLB/CF/ingress)? :thinking:

elaine: Repro from their env using ALB -> nginx ingress in k8s -> our origin. Also sometimes via Cloudflare in front of ALB. Repro steps included curl for streaming and a tiny Node client.

elaine: curl repro:```curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" "https://api.redwood.test/v1/stream?token=REDACTED"``` Response stalls after a prefix, then no bytes for ~15s, then a 1-2 byte fragment and connection close.

vic: Any TLS session reuse or half-close traces? Could be Nagle + TLS coalescing on the proxy causing delayed flush. Also check ALB idle timeouts + keepalive probe configs.

elaine: We captured tcpdump on the ingress node: shows small TLS record sizes then ~15s gap, then a FIN from client side. Snippet:```12:01:07.123 IP client > lb: TLS 80 bytes
12:01:07.124 IP lb > origin: TLS 80 bytes
12:01:22.500 IP client > lb: pure ACK (no data)
12:01:22.501 IP client > lb: FIN
```

kenji: That smells like delayed push on proxy side + Nagle on Linux -> small writes buffered. Are we seeing TCP_CORK or Nagle toggled in ingress/nginx config? Also Cloudflare will coalesce chunks when buffering mode enabled.

elaine: nginx upstream has `proxy_buffering on` for that route (oops). We asked the customer to try `proxy_buffering off` and to disable gzip. They reported lower frequency of truncation but still intermittent.

sam: ops-bot: linked ticket #INC-4219, attached logs and pcap, alerting on client-side reconnect spike > 3/min.

ops-bot: Incident INC-4219 created and assigned to eng-runtime. SLA: respond within 2h.

vic: Next steps: 1) eng-runtime to validate origin's flush behavior (are we coalescing writes in runtime?), 2) eng-infra to audit ALB idle timeout vs keepalive probes, 3) ask customer for a full pcap and Node repro.

kenji: Quick check for runtime: add explicit flush after each event (`res.flush()` / `w.flush()` equivalent) and ensure we set `TCP_NODELAY` on sockets. Also recommend setting `proxy_buffering off` and `sendfile off` on nginx for streaming endpoints.

elaine: FYI billing glitch: reconnects triggered extra token meterings for that customer during retries. Finance wants usage delta slice for the incident window. Marking for billing review.

sam: I’ll pull usage and flag potential credit if spike caused by our proxy behavior.

kenji: I'll spin up a controlled repro in our lab with ALB + CF + nginx + origin and try toggling `TCP_NODELAY`, `proxy_buffering`, and gzip. Will post results.

elaine: Thanks — saving pcap to the ticket and pinging eng-runtime. If anyone sees similar customer threads, link them here so we can batch the workaround docs. :thumbsup:
